known_limitations: Decode only. Profile version 1.0 cannot declare command encoding, so UALC cannot send anything to this appliance from this profile.
Test fixtures are SYNTHETIC, generated by this project's own encoder from the documented field layout. No frame here was captured from a physical appliance.
The trailing 16-bit checksum is not validated; its polynomial has not been independently verified by this project.
Regional SKUs sharing the ThinQ model id AIR_910604_WW have been observed elsewhere to differ in their mode enum. Treat the mode values as the documented family norm, not as confirmed for every unit.

notes: Reference Level-1 profile. The TLV framing and tag numbers are protocol facts from this project's own LG research, corroborated by public reverse-engineering discussion in anszom/rethink (GPL-2.0). No code or captured fixture from that project was copied; see docs/contributing/DEVICE_CONTRIBUTION.md section on licensing.
